cs.t: W Hotels sells their beds through their website, and frequently have "employee only" deals (40-60% off) that become publicly available so often you would think it must be intentional. I bought their "The W Bed" queen set (box spring + mattress) for $705 about 4 years ago that way, and love it. I seem to recall reading somewhere else that it may be a rebranded Simmons Beautyrest, if that helps. As you point out, getting a great mattress and chair is well worth the initial cost.
